$comment: Golden cases of the guild mark and symbol lists (tools/check_nui_snapshots.py; P16 spec 5.11, 12): the mark list's eight files of upload/ (legacy's extensions, sorted), the three 16 x 12 marks with their previews (fixture images in nui/windows/guild-mark/fixture/), the fourth selected; symbol: the symbol list's three jpg files, no previews, the first selected; empty: an empty folder; translucent: modern-dark and modern-light at 80% panel opacity over the synthetic backdrop. Classic is legacy's 170 x 300 board with the list at 15, 50, its thin scroll bar and the small buttons; its art is in assets/ETC. The modern looks' frames are larger than classic's (the 240dp window and its shadow, which the renderer offsets once it crosses the frame's edge), so classic keeps its frames and the modern cases have their own.
